headline: Saturday: mostly sunny, high 23C
illustration_prompt: Extreme wide shot of a nearly empty park in early autumn morning. The horizon sits at the lower third, showing a line of distant trees in muted green and yellow. In the lower-left quadrant, a wooden park bench recedes into the distance, its slats forming thin horizontal lines. At the far end of the bench, a single small paper cup of hojicha sits, tiny against the expanse. A single, curling wisp of steam rises from the cup, catching the low, golden morning light. The rest of the scene is vast, quiet lawn with long shadows stretching from the trees. The sky is pale blue with a few scattered high clouds. Emotional beat: solitude and warmth in a cool, open space. No text, letters, numbers, signs, or logos.
subtitle: A warm hojicha in hand, the cool morning yours.
